answer_1.quote: Generating text from structured inputs such as tables, tuples, or graphs, is commonly referred to as data-to-text generation.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions from structured tables

answer_2.quote: We evaluated model performance automatically with the same metrics used to rank participant systems in the ToTTo leaderboard. These include BLEU which is as a proxy for fluency, PARENT, a metric proposed specifically for data-to-text evaluation that takes the table into account, serving as a proxy of faithfulness, and BLEURT.

answer_4.quote: Crowdworkers were presented with an uncompressed image of a table, its page and section title, and a model generated description. Participants were asked to determine whether a description was "True" or "False" based on the information provided in the table and/or its title and subtitle.
answer_4.guideline: Participants determined if the description is true or false based on faithfulness to the table information.
